payload.title: Fix AI PR review HTTP 403 and validate configured model endpoint
payload.body:
## Reproduction
1. Open or synchronize a pull request.
2. Wait for `.github/workflows/ai-pr-review.yml`.
3. The workflow posts `API error (HTTP 403). Check model config.` instead of a review.

## Pinpointed source
- `.github/workflows/ai-pr-review.yml` selects `AGENT_ENDPOINT` / `BAPX_AI_ENDPOINT`, or falls back to `APP_URL/api/agent`.
- Provider, endpoint shape, model name, and authorization are not preflighted.
- Non-200 responses are reduced to generic output, hiding the provider response needed to diagnose the 403.

## Required fix
- Add credential-safe preflight validation for endpoint, provider and model.
- Support the configured remote-DB model settings without printing secrets.
- Fail the check clearly when review generation fails; do not post a successful-looking review comment containing only an API error.
- Add a deterministic mocked test for Google and OpenAI-compatible response parsing.

## Acceptance
- A test PR receives an actual concise review.
- Invalid configuration produces a failed Action with a useful redacted diagnosis.
- No API key appears in logs or comments.
